summary: The product is the determinant of an (a+1)×(a+1) block of s·w_p·η⁻¹, a matrix of size 7.

steps.lean:
h'.rec fun η ⟨r, h'⟩ ↦ mem_ofSize_mono (by
  have y m d l := inv_mem r m (inl (.castLE a.2 d)) ⟨l, by simp [ha]⟩
  convert det_mem_ofSize _ a.2 fun b d ↦ (o h.2).mul (o h').inv (ite (b = .last _) i
    (eStar (b.castLE a.2))) (inl (d.castLE a.2))
  simp [-coe_units_inv]
  erw [← mul_assoc, det_eq_of_eq_mul_det_one _ (det_eq_one_of_unitriangular fun _ ↦
    (y _ · · |>.trans (by simp))) (ext fun b d ↦ .symm (sum_of_injective _
    (inl_injective.comp (castLE_injective a.2)) _ _ (fun m _ ↦ by dsimp; erw [y] <;> revert m <;>
    simp [Fin.exists_iff] <;> grind) fun _ ↦ rfl)), det_of_isLowerTriangular _ fun b
    d ↦ by simp [mul_apply, *]; grind [unitriGroup_dual_row, one_apply_ne]]
  simp +contextual [prod_univ_castSucc, prod_range, unitriGroup_dual_row h.1, ha.le, mul_apply, *]
  ac_rfl)
steps.claim: Take η ∈ Q_j with η·(w_j(p)⁻¹·g) ∈ K (hypothesis h'). It suffices to show that the product lies in B^S_{8(a+1)} (then monotonicity, 8(a+1) ≤ 9n).

steps.lean: have y m d l := inv_mem r m (inl (.castLE a.2 d)) ⟨l, by simp [ha]⟩
steps.claim: y: η⁻¹ ∈ Q_j (a subgroup), so for d ≤ a and every row m of level at least d, the entry (η⁻¹)_{m,e_d} equals the identity's (e_d has floor and level d < j).

steps.lean:
convert det_mem_ofSize _ a.2 fun b d ↦ (o h.2).mul (o h').inv (ite (b = .last _) i
    (eStar (b.castLE a.2))) (inl (d.castLE a.2))
steps.claim: Let M be the (a+1)×(a+1) matrix with entries M_{bd} = ((sg)(η w_j(p)⁻¹ g)⁻¹)_{row(b), e_d}, row(b) = e*_b for b < a and row(a) = i. As sg ∈ K and ηw_j(p)⁻¹g ∈ K have size 1 (o) and the inverse adds 4, M has size 1 + 5 + 1 = 7, so det M ∈ B^S_{8(a+1)} by det_mem_ofSize (a + 1 ≤ ϱ). It remains to show that det M equals (p_0 ⋯ p_a)·s_{i,e*_a}.

steps.lean:
erw [← mul_assoc, det_eq_of_eq_mul_det_one _ (det_eq_one_of_unitriangular fun _ ↦
    (y _ · · |>.trans (by simp))) (ext fun b d ↦ .symm (sum_of_injective _
    (inl_injective.comp (castLE_injective a.2)) _ _ (fun m _ ↦ by dsimp; erw [y] <;> revert m <;>
    simp [Fin.exists_iff] <;> grind) fun _ ↦ rfl)), det_of_isLowerTriangular _ fun b
    d ↦ by simp [mul_apply, *]; grind [unitriGroup_dual_row, one_apply_ne]]
steps.claim: det M = det of the corresponding block of s·w_j(p): the block of η⁻¹ on the columns e_d, d ≤ a, restricted to the rows that matter is unitriangular by y, so has determinant 1; the remaining (a+1)×(a+1) block of s·w_j(p) is lower triangular (s ∈ Q_j has identity dual rows, unitriGroup_dual_row), so its determinant is the product of its diagonal entries.

steps.lean:
simp +contextual [prod_univ_castSucc, prod_range, unitriGroup_dual_row h.1, ha.le, mul_apply, *]
  ac_rfl)
steps.claim: The diagonal entries are p_b for b < a (w_j(p) sends e_b to p_b e*_b and the dual row of s at e*_b is that of the identity) and p_a·s_{i,e*_a} at the last row; their product is (p_0 ⋯ p_a)·s_{i,e*_a}.
